title: Conditional R-488 nonzero sector-weight obligation
purpose: Formalize the exact finite implication that a grade-blind R-488 cylinder with a zero Q=0 component and a positive Q=1 component is globally nonzero only if the Q=1 sector receives positive weight. The weight remains an unspecified variable; no PAH sector law is selected.

fixed_scope.carrier_and_path: Use exactly the PAH-OMC-004 two-row strip and the PAH-OMC-010 finite path inherited by PAH-OMC-014; this bridge takes no refinement, cutoff, volume or phase limit.
fixed_scope.cylinder: Use the unchanged grade-blind R-488 cylinder f=ell_a at n=2, with Q=0 and Q=1 components on the PAH-OMC-012 graded union.
fixed_scope.component_values: The Q=0 component has phi_0(ell_a)=0; the Q=1 component has phi_1(ell_a)>0 from the exact finite Gibbs positive witness in R-492.
fixed_scope.variable_sector_values: For arbitrary real w0,w1,a1, define V=w0*0+w1*a1. The Lean bridge proves V=w1*a1, V!=0 iff w1>0 when w1>=0 and a1>0, and any lower bound delta<=V with delta>0 forces w1>0.
fixed_scope.weight_policy: w0 and w1 are symbolic nonnegative variables only. No normalized source law, fitted weight, delta law, beta dependence, phase dependence or cross-Q kernel is introduced.

lean.scope: Abstract two-component real algebra instantiated only with the R-492 finite zero/positive witness signs.

assumptions: the Q=0 component value is exactly zero
a global nonzero or positive lower bound is being tested for the same cylinder
theorem_contract.conclusion: The finite mixture value is w1*a1; it is nonzero exactly when w1>0, and a positive uniform lower bound cannot hold when w1=0.
theorem_contract.PAH_instantiation: R-492 supplies the Q=0 ell_a zero fact and the Q=1 finite-Gibbs positive witness. The source-owned w_(n,R,Q) and any liminf lower bound remain absent.

missing_inputs: A source-authorized hash-pinned normalized full-Q sector law or projective kernel.
A source-owned topology and Cauchy error under the fixed PAH-001 order.
A source-owned lower-bound or asymptotic statement ensuring the positive R-488 component receives enough weight for global nonzero.
A common stationarity domain and uniform-integrability estimate for omega(Lf)=0.
boundaries: This is conditional algebra and an exact finite obligation, not a sector-law construction.
It does not prove projective consistency, weak cylinder convergence, positivity of a global state, stationarity, closability or an infinite-volume limit.
R-484 defect 16/9 and R-490 C_sw=540 are untouched; C_sw is not a measure or sector weight.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion is made.
